# 1 Getting Started

## **1.1 Installing and loading the packages**



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, jsonlite, 
               SmartEDA, tidygraph,
               ggraph)
```
:::



## **1.2 Data import**



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
kg <- fromJSON("data/MC1_graph.json")
```
:::



## 1.3 Inspect structure



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
str(kg, max.level = 1)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
List of 5
 $ directed  : logi TRUE
 $ multigraph: logi TRUE
 $ graph     :List of 2
 $ nodes     :'data.frame':	17412 obs. of  10 variables:
 $ links     :'data.frame':	37857 obs. of  4 variables:
```


:::
:::



# 2 Extract and inspect



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
nodes_tb1 <- as_tibble(kg$nodes)
edges_tb1 <- as_tibble(kg$links)
```
:::



## 2.1 Initial EDA



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
ggplot(data = edges_tb1,
       aes(y = `Edge Type`)) +
  geom_bar()
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](In-class_Ex01_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-5-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::



Step 1: Mapping from node id to row index



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
id_map <- tibble(id = nodes_tb1$id,
                 index = seq_len(
                   nrow(nodes_tb1)
                 ))
```
:::



This ensures each id from your node list is mapped to the correct row number.

Step 2 : Map source and target IDs to row



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
edges_tb1 <- edges_tb1 %>%
  left_join(id_map, by = c("source" = "id")) %>%
  rename(from = index) %>%
  left_join(id_map, by = c("target" = "id")) %>%
  rename(to = index)
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
edges_tb1 <- edges_tb1 %>%
  filter(!is.na(from), !is.na(to))
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
graph <- tbl_graph(nodes = nodes_tb1,
                   edges = edges_tb1,
                   directed = kg$directed)
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
set.seed(1234)
```
:::



Visualising the whole Graph



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
ggraph(graph, layout = "fr") +
  geom_edge_link(alpha = 0.3,
                 colour = "gray") + 
  geom_node_point(aes(colour = `Node Type`),
                 size = 4) +
  geom_node_text(aes(label = name),
                 repel =  TRUE,
                 size = 2.5) +
  theme_void()
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
graph_memberof <- graph %>%
  activate(edges) %>%
  filter(`Edge Type` == "Memberof")
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
used_node_indices <- graph_memberof %>%
  activate(edges) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  select(from, to) %>%
  unlist() %>%
  unique()
```
:::



Step 3 : Keep only those nodes



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
graph_memberof <- graph_memberof %>%
  activate(nodes) %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  filter(row_id %in% used_node_indices) %>%
  select(-row_id) #optional cleanup
```
:::
